1.explanation: This minimal React app imports the SCSS for the CodeSnippet component first, then the SCSS for CopyButton, matching the import order mentioned in the bug report. You render a single-line CodeSnippet, which under the hood renders a CopyButton with an inline style of {position: 'absolute', top: '1rem', right: '1rem'}. However, because the .bx--copy-btn class coming later in your stylesheet has position: relative, the button ends up relatively positioned inside the snippet instead of absolutely at the top right. By running this code with carbon‐components@10.9.0 and carbon‐components‐react@7.9.0, you will see the copy button mispositioned exactly as in the screenshot.
1.bug_scenario: When you render a single‐line CodeSnippet in React (type="single") and import the SCSS for code‐snippet before the SCSS for copy‐button, the little copy‐to‐clipboard button (the CopyButton) ends up positioned relative to its container rather than absolutely at the top right. In the screenshot you’ll see the button sitting down in the body of the snippet instead of floated at the top right corner.
